name: Azeroth Companion
title: Player Information Center — Complete Guide & Compatibility
features: Added a dedicated Information & Player Guide tab accessible throughout the companion on PC and iPhone.
Introduced a nine-step beginner walkthrough with saved checklist, optional Battle.net connection and direct links to working tools.
Documented sixteen feature areas with searchable descriptions of practical gameplay value, limitations and manual versus Blizzard-reported information.
Added real-world party, dungeon, raid, farming, equipment and cross-device scenarios for players and friends.
Added a release panel that retrieves the latest hosted Azeroth companion version and recent releases from validated site metadata.
Published honest modern Retail WoW support boundaries, a dated 12.1.5 game-patch reference and official Blizzard patch-note links, with Classic and PTR support explicitly unverified.
Added clear FAQs for secure account login, missing characters, verified-session expiry, manual ownership tracking, backup transfer and browser deployment.
Published a clearly labeled future roadmap and responsive accessibility-aware guide without modifying account permissions or player records.
